about: The fidelity contract's performance scene (scripts/fidelity/contract.py, scene perf): a performance item open in the wide compare panel (both tables at the panel's full width), the winner A/1's sample-perf-1 against the first item of Kettle's sample pack k-perf-1 (Athena has no performance pack). Only the performance table's roles: the rest of the page is held by roles.json on Athena.

perf-head.why: column widths: the port moves the range strip under its row (a 7-column table that fits the docked panel; the winner's 9 columns overflowed it by 325 px and clipped Spread and the range) and the scene compares Kettle's sample numbers with the winner's; type, padding and borders hold. Structural, not owner-accepted: the Director confirms
